scope: real local Console/MinIO and two native release BoxLite Workers; cross-worker snapshot and separate initial-session offline-expiry regression
platform: macOS arm64 host, Linux arm64 guest

creation_record.normalization: SDK BoxOptions.sanitize before intent; canonical JSON with recursively sorted object keys and ordered arrays; actual stored options hashed without re-normalizing

cross_worker.target_sdk_image_cache: cold before restore, warm after restore; checked by the pinned SDK cache probe and pull/reuse log receipts

limits: Both Workers are on one physical host; no cross-physical-host or Linux VM acceptance claim.

These runs complete ordinary creation, snapshot/resume and known initial-expiry cleanup. Interruption within create-to-ID-selection/boot windows is modeled by durable journal/reopen tests, not an actual SDK instruction-level crash in these runs.

Unfinished creation intents retain data and reject SDK initialization, including an empty SDK home. Automatic coordination/termination of those intents, unknown native roots and history maintenance remain incomplete.
A 1 MiB correctness regression with cold target SDK cache is not a performance matrix, percentile or production SLO.
